title: One AI Built a 1.4MB Shooter in 8 Hours
script: An AI built a playable 3D shooter inside one HTML file. It’s called Saltline. Anthropic engineer Felix Rieseberg used Claude Fable 5.2 with an initial prompt and no human feedback during the run. About eight hours later, the result was a first-person shooter set in a rainy industrial harbor. The whole game is roughly 1.4 megabytes. No separate image files. No separate audio files. No 3D model downloads. Geometry, textures, and sound are generated through code. The reported run used around 2.7 million output tokens and 445 million input tokens, with an estimated API-equivalent cost around five hundred fifty dollars. Saltline isn’t a full AAA game. But it proves what one AI can build when the scope is tight.
